messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a gradual redirect of traffic from router-v2 -> router-v3 tonight during the 00:45Z change window. Rough plan: canary -> ramp -> drain old pods. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.2.0 :link:
Mira: Got it. What are the warmup / drain timings? need to prime KV cache? :eyes:
Alex: Warmup: 10m pre-warm (traffic shadowing), canary at 5% for 5m, then 25% for 10m, then 60% for 10m, final cutover. Drain: 3m graceful connection drain on old pool after each step. KV cache: we'll run a light shadow run during warmup to populate prefix cache.
Sam: Who's on watch for p95 and errors? Also pin older model/version for fallback?
Paula: Rollback criteria proposal: p95 latency > 200ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m => immediate abort & revert to pinned routing. Also monitor tail OOM-ish logs.
Len: Suggest pinning router-v2 at the route level for a safe fallback: route pin=router-v2 with 30% emergency reserve capacity.
Alex: Agreed. We'll pin router-v2 as fallback target and keep a 30% reserve. Adding metrics: p95, 99th, 5xx rate, qps, retry-rate.
DeployBot: plan created by Alex. ID: RB-2026-6175000000. To start the rollout run:
```
/deploy start --service router --version router-v3 --strategy gradual --steps 5 --pause 300 --canary 5
```
DeployBot: preflight checks: infra-green, canary-images-present, lb-config-valid. All checks passed.
Mira: I'll run the shadow traffic and watch KV hit-rate. Will post a quick check at each step.
Sam: I'll head up rollback if thresholds breach. If abort, command will be:
```
/deploy abort --id RB-2026-6175000000 --fallback router-v2
```
Paula: Small note on sessions — session-stickiness is preserved, but we should expect some transient 4xx during drain. Add a 2m stabilization buffer after each step.
Len: Agree on stabilization buffer. Also recommend adding a cohort pin for internal traffic only for first two steps.
Alex: OK cohort pin for internal traffic at 20% first step. Public canary 5% as DeployBot shows.
DeployBot: starting rollout step 1 -> 5% at 00:45:15Z. Expected pause 300s. 
Mira: Shadow priming started. KV hit-rate up from 0% -> ~12% after 3m.
Sam: Watching p95: currently 98ms, 5xx=0.02%. All green. :thumbsup:
Paula: monitoring alert hooks set. Pager only if threshold hit.
Alex: If step1 stable at 5m, we'll proceed to step2 (25%). After step2 we'll wait 10m and check top-of-stack logs for errors and hallucination/regression signals from eval probes.
Mira: Noted — running eval probes during the 10m window.
DeployBot: step1 passed health checks. Moving to step2 -> 25% at 00:51:20Z.
Sam: Step2 p95=110ms, 5xx=0.04%, retry-rate slightly up but within threshold. Proceeding.
Paula: No sign of tail increase yet. Continuing watch.
Alex: If anything crosses thresholds, Sam will abort and Len will coordinate routing revert.
Len: If abort, we'll route traffic to pinned router-v2 and scale it up as needed. 
Mira: Shadow run completed. KV hit-rate ~45%, prefix cache seeded.
DeployBot: step3 -> 60% at 01:05:40Z. Pause 600s for validation.
Sam: Seeing p95=140ms, 5xx=0.12% (still below 0.5%). Watch queue lengths on inference workers.
Paula: Keep eye on tail latency; set temporary alert if p99 > 350ms.
Alex: Final cutover scheduled after validation window if metrics stable. Post-deploy tasks: update release notes with rollout timeline, update runbook with observed anomalies, and schedule post-mortem if we hit rollback.
DeployBot: rollout complete at 01:15:00Z. Final state: router-v3=100%, router-v2=draining.
Len: Evac of old pool initiated, drain expected complete in ~4m.
Sam: All green from observability side. Will leave a 1h watch.
Paula: Marking change window closed. I'll file a short blip in release notes about the canary timings.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Great coordination. If anything pops, ping this thread and run `/deploy abort --id RB-2026-6175000000`. :party_parrot:
